title: The Plant Moved into the Light for You
youtube_title: The Plant Moved into the Light for You | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A thank-you that takes effort feels true.
summary: At a library corner with a paper ribbon in a book, Noemi notices that Mr. Ade has already taken care of a plant moved into the light because you worried. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Noemi does one useful thing Mr. Ade did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
